title: Came as a family with two...
text: Came as a family with two little ones in a stroller and the guides were so friendly and considerate. Highly recommend the tour in order to get a better understanding and appreciation of the background and beautiful architecture. A great experience. I am so thankful!
author: Veronica_C

title: Must do experience
text: Gaudí is fascinating and amazing. Best to see his works in Sagrada Familia and Park Guell with a guide. There is so much interesting history and architectural insights to know.
author: Michelle_Y

title: 2 Separate Tours but Perfect to Skip the Lines
text:
These are 2 separate tours with 2 different meeting points and guides. This could be MUCH clearer in the initial description so that travel plans to each location can be can accounted for. (Taxi access is relatively easy) Technically, each tour is a little over an hour and 15 minutes. After the first one, you can’t linger too much in your free time in order to make the next one. You definitely have time to stay as long as you want after the second one.

author: Staci_N

title: Recommended for Solo traveler
text:
I would definitely recommend this tour package, especially for solo travelers. The tourist guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional, and made me feel comfortable and well taken care of throughout the trip. It was a great experience, and I would happily book with them again!

Visiting the Sagrada Família and Park Güell is a must when exploring Barcelona. Both places were absolutely beautiful and made the trip even more memorable. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: jonahpot07

title: Great double feature
text:
Albert was our exceptional guide for La Sagrada Familia. He was punctual and precise and advised of all steps we would be taking as a group through the cathedral.  He also offered an amazing suggestion for a cafe afterwards. He felt like familia.
Marta was our great guide for Park Guell. She took us through the amazing history of the park and shared with us many interesting facts. She was also instrumental in providing directions after the tour to get us to the metro.
author: B2512SMamandap

title: Sagrada de Familla Tour
text: Marc our tour guide did an amazing job explaining the east and west structures of the building. Detailing the Birth, the Passion and the Glory (still in progress) of Jesus Christ. Walking this tour on my own i would not have learned or understood Guide vision for this magnificent church. Was truly an amazing experience. This is a must.
author: Brian_H

title: Bucket List Success!
text: Park Güell & La Sagrada have been on my bucket list for years. Jordie took us around Park Güell, he was funny & knowledgeable! Gloria was our guide for the La Sagrada portion, she was enchanting and animated! Both guides made the experience everything I could have imagined!  Definitely take the afternoon tour to grab Golden Hour at La Sagrada, 100% breathtaking!
author: Kristen_D

title: Recommend for Barcelona
text: Great way to see the sights in Barcelona. Easy meet up and clear communication with the tour company
author: Kendall_C

title: A must do tour of the Sagrada Família and Park Güell
text: This was a fantastic duo tour of the Sagrada Família and Park Güell. Both tour guides were very knowledgeable and polite. Both tours were about 1-1 and a half hours long. I would highly recommend this due to the reasonable price and interesting information you receive during the tour.
author: Vacation41568862573

title: Couldn’t image this tour without Olga E!
text: Our tour of Sagrada Família with Olga E was absolutely amazing! She was so knowledgeable and brought the entire experience to life. I truly can’t imagine seeing this incredible place without understanding the history, symbolism, imagery, architecture, and materials behind it all. Olga made us notice and appreciate so many details we would have completely missed on our own. Highly recommend her tour!
author: shannon_s
